title: Global travel advisories
description: Multiple countries closed borders and urged citizens abroad to return as WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic.

title: EU Digital COVID Certificate
description: EU members agreed on a digital certificate to facilitate safe travel for vaccinated, tested, or recovered citizens.

title: Expanded Omicron testing
description: African CDC coordinated cross-border antigen testing to slow early Omicron spread.

title: Mask mandates relaxed (Japan)
description: Japan shifted from mandatory indoor masking to guidance-based policies as hospitalizations fell.

title: Bivalent booster rollout (US)
description: CDC expanded updated booster eligibility to all adults to improve protection during winter.
